setup_logging_with_config: setup logging using a JSON config file and a save directory for log output
setup_logging_default_level: setup logging with a default log level when no config file is found
setup_logging_handlers: setup logging handlers that write log files to a specified save directory
review_setup_logging: review the setup_logging function to understand how it configures logging from a JSON file
refactor_setup_logging: refactor setup_logging to support additional logging configuration options beyond JSON files
